jobs.name: amu-claim-chain
jobs.prompt:
Continue the amu speed-claim chain. One tick = one task, in order, from the plan at
~/github/com-junkawasaki/.hermes/plans/2026-09-07_092400-amu-claim-chain.md

READ THAT PLAN FIRST, every tick. It carries the measured current state, the six tasks in
dependency order, and ten non-optional workspace rules. Do not re-derive what it already
measured; do not skip ahead past Task 1, because Tasks 2 and 3 cannot produce a qualified
number until Task 1 opens the host gate.

Authoritative context, already landed: ADR 0341 in kotoba-lang/amu (PR #851) and the sealed
claim at bench/runtime-comparison/jb-imod-control-claim-20260906.edn. The live co-scientist
ladder is docs/codegen-coSCientist.md (iteration 122c) — note that docs/codegen-cosientist.md,
one letter different, is a STALE duplicate that already caused one wrong decision. Task 6
retires it.

The three rules that matter most, because each one has already been violated once and cost
real work:

1. Measure on a fleet node, never on this workstation. On 2026-09-06, 8 of 10 fleet nodes
   passed the quiet gate on the first probe while the workstation read load1 32-64. The 174
   rank ticks recorded as "no measured verdicts" were a placement error, not a scarcity of
   quiet machines. Reachable nodes: levi, asher, dan, joseph, judah, benjamin (naphtali and
   issachar were unreachable; simeon and zebulun answered once then timed out).
2. Gate on busy-CPU fraction, not loadavg: 1 - dIdle/dTotal from os.cpus() over 1-second
   windows, <= 0.10 for three consecutive samples. load1 on these machines has a floor above
   1.0 with every CPU idle (ADR 0281), and it is also too permissive — it passed a host that
   had a full core occupied by another agent's benchmark.
3. Before taking a node, check whether someone else is measuring on it
   (ps -axo pcpu,etime,command | sort -rn | head). Two agents collided on judah on 2026-09-06
   and corrupted each other's runs. Never kill another user's process; take a different node
   or wait, and say which you did.

Never fabricate a measurement. If the host is not quiet, or a tool is missing, or a check
could not run, report "not measured" and stop for this tick — that is a legitimate result
here, and it is what the existing tick log does. A number you did not observe is the worst
possible output.

kotoba-lang/amu main is a protected branch: gh api .../merges returns 409, so PRs are the
only landing path. No rebase, no force-push, no new .github/workflows, no new .sh or .mjs
files (nbb .cljs only), no bb.

End each tick by reporting: which task you advanced, what you measured with the host and the
busy fraction beside it, what you landed (PR URL), and what the next tick should do first.
